data.body: B-late-renewal-overjoin: _late_renewal joins the lease displayed at that moment into the contest whether or not it overlapped anyone (test_divergence _three_hops: carol [6000,7800] contested though only alice/bob overlapped). Kept in B-fix-contest-gaps because resolve refuses a keep that is the displayed lease but not a contestant. Probe on main (bbbe066): three_hops keep carol exits 0, releases nothing, and leaves alice/bob contested -- so the over-join never actually let the current holder win; and a plain double claim followed by a clean TTL takeover (alice 1000, bob 1500, carol 9000) refuses --keep carol outright. Fix: resolve accepts the displayed lease, and when it met none of the contest releases every contestant (each ended before it took the item); then _late_renewal joins only pairwise overlaps. Property tests: exact contest with renewals.
data.title: A late renewal joins only the claims it overlapped; resolve can keep the current holder when it met none of the contest (fixes bug B-late-renewal-overjoin)

data.summary: resolve cannot settle a contest in favour of the current holder when that holder met none of the contestants (pre-existing on main bbbe066, independent of any late renewal). Plain double claim then clean TTL takeover: alice 1000+1800, bob 1500+1800, carol 9000+1800 -> contest [alice,bob], carol displayed; 'resolve T --keep carol' exits 1 'names none of T's contestants'. With the late-renewal over-join (test_divergence _three_hops) carol IS a contestant, and 'resolve --keep carol' exits 0, releases nothing, and leaves alice/bob contested -- a success that settled nothing. So the over-join B-late-renewal-overjoin kept for this never made it work. Only ways out today hand the item back to a lapsed claim and release the live holder.

data.claim: The over-join does not make it possible: on main, keeping a displayed holder that overlapped no one settles nothing (exit 0, contest unchanged) when it was over-joined, and is refused when it was not. The fix belongs in resolve (accept the displayed lease; when it met none of the contest, every contestant ended before it took the item and is released), after which _late_renewal can join pairwise overlaps only.
data.falsifier: On main, resolve --keep carol on _three_hops(1500) leaves an empty contest with carol holding

data.rule: A trade-off justified by 'this keeps feature X working' must be checked by exercising X through its real entry point on the unchanged code, not inferred from the data shape
data.title: Before keeping a known defect 'because removing it breaks X', run X end to end on the old code
data.why: B-late-renewal-overjoin was kept in B-fix-contest-gaps so that 'resolve --keep <current holder>' would work; on main that resolve exited 0, released nothing and left the contest standing, and without a late renewal it was refused outright. The over-join bought nothing; the real fix was in resolve
